name: ibis budget Singapore Sapphire
short_description: A 2-star, 60-room ecocertified budget hotel on Lorong 10 Geylang, about a 10-minute walk from Kallang MRT and the National Stadium.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Sapphire sits at 3 Lorong 10 Geylang, in the same Geylang cluster as several sister ibis budget properties, about a 10-minute walk from Kallang MRT Station and the Singapore National Stadium, and roughly a 10-minute drive from the Central Business District (15 minutes to Orchard Road, 20 minutes to Changi Airport). The ecocertified economy hotel has 60 rooms across three room types (12-15 sqm), free WiFi, and a car park. Its own Accor listing shows a strong 4.6/5 guest rating from 27 reviews, while TripAdvisor's larger sample rates it 3/5 (ranked roughly #210 of 379 Singapore hotels), with guests praising clean rooms, friendly staff, and good value, though noting small room sizes and a longer check-in process. A confirmed YouTube room-tour review corroborates the compact, clean, budget-tier rooms. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme's points or elite-tier benefits.

elite_benefits: ALL - Accor Live Limitless members can book member-exclusive rates
core_facts.elite_notes: This property does not participate in ALL points earning, redemption, or elite-tier benefits, per its official ALL listing; ALL members can still book member rates here, but a stay earns no points and carries no status benefits.

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Singapore Sapphire part of the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- despite the ibis budget/Accor branding, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, though ALL member rates may still apply.

faqs.question: How far is ibis budget Singapore Sapphire from the airport?
faqs.answer: It's about a 20-minute drive from Changi International Airport. Locally, the hotel is roughly a 10-minute walk from Kallang MRT Station and the Singapore National Stadium, with the Central Business District about 10 minutes away by car and Orchard Road around 15 minutes.
